maker: Rasmus Lerdorf, then the PHP community
summary: The language that built much of the dynamic web. Rasmus Lerdorf wrote it to run his own home page; it went on to power WordPress, Wikipedia and Facebook's early years.

icon.licence: CC0 1.0 (the mark itself belongs to its owner)

events.note: Rasmus Lerdorf announces "Personal Home Page Tools" on Usenet.

events.label: PHP 3
events.note: A rewrite by Zeev Suraski and Andi Gutmans; the name becomes "PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor".

events.label: PHP 4
events.note: Runs on the new Zend Engine.

events.label: PHP 5
events.note: Adds a new object model and exceptions.

events.label: PHP 6 dropped
events.note: The Unicode rewrite planned as PHP 6 is abandoned; the next version is 7.

events.label: PHP 7
events.note: Roughly twice as fast, on Zend Engine 3.

events.label: PHP Foundation
events.note: JetBrains and others set up the PHP Foundation to pay core developers.
